skill_name: Summarise the contents of this website.
workflow: AA.com is the official website of American Airlines, one of the world’s largest airlines. On their website, you can book flights, check in, manage your travel, explore different destinations and vacation packages, and learn more about the American Airlines AAdvantage program.  You can also use the website to join or manage your AAdvantage account, and receive up to date information on the latest travel related news and safety information.
